_comment: Edit decision list — Real World 'The Mission' trailer. Machine-readable source of truth for TRAILER-PLAN.md §3/§7. Consumed by build-animatic.py. Timing in seconds at fps below. 'recapture' marks shots that MUST be re-cut from live game footage before ship; stills are pre-production only.

shots.title: possession briefing

shots.note: Design §7 verbatim: briefing = public profile + surface relationships + daily routine; own and others' secrets redacted. The sealed rows are the thesis.

shots.note: The break lands in silence — no sting, no narrator. An unexpected choice (or an unexplained absence) is the hook.

shots.title: since you last watched
shots.card: You leave for a week. The block keeps score.
shots.note: CONCEPT UI — the production-3 'catch-up edition': up to three verified changes since the viewer's last visit (Astra direction §5). Not a shipped screen yet; the mock sells the return loop, and 'verified' is the load-bearing word.

shots.card: Same street. A different neighborhood.
shots.note: The return beat — familiar framing, shifted light. Consequence continuity is visible, not claimed.

lines: DAY 12  15:00  Tomás came back. Mars had kept the seat.
DAY 12  15:41  He stayed forty minutes past the usual.
DAY 12  15:43  Priya stopped by. First time in weeks.
shots.card: A choice on day 10 changed day 12. Nobody scripted it.
shots.note: The payoff: observable consequence, no inferred motive. Every line is an event a viewer could have watched happen — never a peek at hidden memory (Astra §5: never present hidden state as public fact).

shots.stamp: NO STAKES — JUST YOUR NAME ON IT
shots.card: Make the call. Come back and check.
shots.note: CONCEPT UI — the non-wager prediction beat of the free observer loop (catch up → follow → predict → inspect → return). Deliberately stakeless: no wager, no reward, just a marked guess to revisit.

shots.title: since you last watched
shots.card: 1 · Catch up. The block kept score.
shots.note: CONCEPT UI — production-3 catch-up edition (≤3 verified changes since last visit, Astra §5). Same Tomás thread as the Consequence Cut so the two cuts can cross-link; 'verified' is load-bearing — only observable events, never inferred motive.

shots.title: follow a thread
shots.card: 2 · Choose someone to follow.
shots.note: CONCEPT UI — thread following (Astra §5: subscribe to a character or commitment). 'public feed only' row is the accuracy guard: following grants attention, not access — no private state is unlocked.

shots.title: your call
shots.stamp: NO STAKES — JUST YOUR NAME ON IT
shots.card: 3 · Make the call. Nothing riding on it but being right.
shots.note: CONCEPT UI — the non-wager prediction (Astra §6). Stamp is verbatim from the Consequence Cut's R8: a marked guess, never a bet. No betting/wagering mechanics exist or are implied.

lines: DAY 13  15:00  the corner seat stayed empty.
DAY 13  15:02  Tomás took the window table instead.
DAY 13  15:04  Mars brought his usual over anyway.
shots.card: 4 · Check what actually happened.
shots.note: The inspect-the-outcome beat. All three lines are observable events — the prediction resolves against footage, not a scoreboard. 'Mars brought his usual' is consequence texture, not a claimed motive.

shots.line: DAY 13 · 15:02 — your call missed. Now you know him better.
shots.card: 5 · Being wrong is the interesting part.
shots.note: Revise-your-understanding beat — the loop's honest payoff: a missed prediction is information, not a loss. No penalty surface exists, so none is shown.

shots.card: 6 · Come back tomorrow. The thread keeps going.
shots.note: Return beat — park overhead under the dusk grade. Exterior still may ship in a pinch; recapture nice-to-have.

thumbnails.note: The watcher: darkened director shot, red REC dot, small title. Sells the Truman-Show premise.
The handoff: same street shot split down the middle, AI | YOU. Sells the possession hook — hired character only at ship. Name tags redact-blurred so AI|YOU can't read as possessing a main.
The block at dusk: night grade, wordmark only. Quietest option; best for press embeds.
The inside: café interior under the REC bug — we watch them indoors too. HUD-free crop; Mudhaus plaque is a parody name.
